title: Start as a freelancer
tagline: From your first invoice to a business that runs itself: account, Peppol invoicing, a reserve for every bill, pension and income protection.
trigger: Salary stopped and a first client invoice was paid in, or a stated 'I'm going freelance'.

steps.title: Keep business and private money apart
steps.description: A business account and card, so client payments and business costs no longer mix with the household budget.
steps.why: Opened in the app with your company number. Your accountant gets one clean statement.

win.customer: A clean split for your accountant

steps.result: Business PRO account opened. {first_client} has the new IBAN for your next invoice.

steps.title: Move work purchases to the business side
steps.description: Business costs you paid privately are flagged and sent to your accountant with the receipt, so they can count as costs.
steps.why: KBC spotted the purchases on your private account; nothing leaves KBC without your accountant's address.

win.customer: Costs that may lower your tax are not forgotten
win.kbc: Daily use of the business app

steps.result: Expense claim sent to your accountant: €{private_expenses_total} ({private_expenses_items}).

steps.title: Invoice the right way: Peppol
steps.description: Send and receive invoices over Peppol, matched automatically with the payments on your business account.
steps.why: Structured e-invoicing between Belgian businesses is mandatory from 1 January 2026 (check the details with your accountant). Billit is an accredited Peppol access point; it sees your company, not your bank data.
steps.result: Billit linked: your next invoice to {first_client} goes out over Peppol and is matched automatically when paid.

steps.title: Never be surprised by a bill
steps.description: Every paid invoice automatically moves the VAT, an income-tax estimate and a regularisation buffer into a separate reserve.
steps.why: Starters pay provisional social contributions on a minimum income. When your real income is higher, the difference is charged about two years later. KBC sees your invoices, so the reserve calculates itself.

win.customer: VAT, tax and the regularisation covered in advance

steps.result: Reserve active: about {reserve_pct}% of every paid invoice is set aside (VAT, income tax, and {regularisation_pct}% for the expected regularisation of about €{regularisation_gap} a year, around {regularisation_due}). €{reserve_now} is already in it. Estimates, adjusted as your income changes.

steps.title: Advance tax payments, planned
steps.description: Spread your income tax over the year with advance payments, paid from the reserve on the due dates.
steps.why: Without advance payments the self-employed usually pay a surcharge on their tax. Starters may be exempt in their first years; paying in advance still avoids one big bill.

win.customer: No tax surcharge, no lump sum

steps.result: Advance tax plan ready: about €{advance_tax_quarter} a quarter, the first payment by {advance_tax_next}, taken from your reserve after your confirmation.

steps.title: Start-up advice and social insurance
steps.description: Start it @KBC and the Boostpack check your set-up: enterprise registration, social insurance fund, VAT regime and accountant.
steps.why: One conversation instead of five offices. We pre-fill what we already know.

win.customer: Set up correctly from day one

steps.result: Starter check done: registered on {kbo_date}, provisional contributions of about €{social_provisional_quarter} a quarter confirmed with your social insurance fund.

steps.title: Close the pension gap
steps.description: Supplementary pension for the self-employed: the statutory pension of a freelancer is lower than an employee's.
steps.why: Calculated on your income from invoices. Contributions are generally deductible as a business cost (within legal limits).

win.customer: Pension gap closed with a tax advantage

steps.result: Supplementary pension started: about €{vapz_monthly} a month, taken from the reserve.

steps.title: Income if you fall ill
steps.description: Guaranteed income insurance: as a freelancer you no longer get an employer's salary when you're ill, and the statutory benefit is small.
steps.why: Covers the gap the statutory system leaves for the self-employed.

win.customer: Income keeps coming when you're ill

steps.result: Guaranteed income insurance active: about €{income_insured_monthly} a month after a 30-day waiting period.

steps.title: Professional liability
steps.description: Cover if a client claims damage from your work.
steps.why: Many clients ask for it in the contract.
steps.result: Professional liability insurance active. Certificate saved in your digital vault.

steps.title: Keep the paperwork
steps.description: Invoices, contracts, the enterprise registration and insurance certificates in one place.
steps.why: Stored at KBC; you decide who sees what.

win.customer: Everything in one place for your accountant

steps.result: Digital vault ready: your registration of {kbo_date} and your first invoice are filed.
